#+TITLE: Citation export
#+AUTHOR: Test Author
#+BIBLIOGRAPHY: refs.bib

* Styles
Plain [cite:@knuth1984] uses Typst's normal form.

Prose [cite/t:@knuth1984] renders the author inline.

Author only [cite/a:@knuth1984].

Year only [cite/na:@knuth1984].

Full entry [cite/b:@lamport1994].

Uncited but listed [cite/n:@lamport1994].

* Locators and affixes
A locator becomes a supplement [cite:@knuth1984 pp. 27-29].

Several keys in one citation [cite:@knuth1984; @lamport1994].

A citation carrying prefix and suffix text [cite:see @knuth1984 for more];
Typst has no pre-note, so both fold into the supplement, joined by a
single space rather than running together.

Prefix text only [cite:see @knuth1984].

Suffix text only [cite:@knuth1984 for more].

* Bibliography
The exporter has no =#+PRINT_BIBLIOGRAPHY= handling yet — the keyword
below exports to nothing — so the bibliography is emitted by hand with
a =#+TYPST:= passthrough, which is also what makes =#cite= calls
resolve when the output is compiled.

#+PRINT_BIBLIOGRAPHY:

#+TYPST: #bibliography("refs.bib")
